duplicate_policy: Within each second, base datagrams are indexed by ascending packet ID then ordinal. The final128 output slots copy base indices0..127 byte-for-byte (60 Motion,20 Session,48 Lap). Duplicates are6.25% of total received traffic and remain in raw MCAP.
send_policy: Emit2048 slots per second at slot/2048 offsets. Base1920 slots precede128 duplicates. History11 cycles carIdx0..23 forty times; TyreSets12 cycles0..23 twenty times. Use128-bit seed-independent counters for expected transmitted count/bytes and a receiver-intake digest independent from the recorder.
coverage_policy: IDs8,9,14 occur once in separate prelude/postlude fixtures outside the healthy count; they are not periodically injected into an active race. This is a declared synthetic stress mix, not a claim about actual game packet frequencies.

reorder_policy.rule: Swap adjacent pairs of original high-rate slots0..63; retain identical send count/bytes and record the exact transmitted order.

event_policy.packet3_default: BUTN with buttonStatus cycling0,1,0,2 by ordinal
event_policy.race_control_fields: Use the supplied2026 v1.2 typed fixtures for partial-aero/overtake events in separate rare-event tests.

header_policy: Use the canonical2026 packet fixtures from go-telemetry-core,24 active cars, player0, formula13, same game UID/source. Patch overallFrameIdentifier=floor(global_slot*60/2048), sessionTime=overallFrame/60 minus active rewind offsets, frameIdentifier follows game timeline. Keep exact packet lengths.

dynamic_values.remaining_fields: Use meaningful typed baseline golden fixture values/sentinels; the fixture hash is pinned before the soak and recorded in evidence. Do not replace payloads with zero-filled short datagrams.

phases.action: cancel a strategy invocation carrying the SC event; next input must retain it
flashback30seconds; preserve raw datagrams and surviving-prefix branch
slow then reconnect Pit wall browser, UDP unchanged

loss_oracle: Compare the fixed expected sender counts/bytes with OS receive counters and receiver-intake counts/digest. Compare receiver-intake counts/digest to reopened MCAP receive-order payloads. Never redefine expected traffic as whatever the recorder admitted. Report source/OS loss separately; absence of OS counters is unavailable, not zero.
